name: text

name: html
description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use within the legend. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

name: caller
description: Not strictly an option but supports the [`call` block](https://mozilla.github.io/nunjucks/templating.html#call) as an alternative to the `html` option. To use it, you will need to wrap the entire legend component in a `call` block.
